audit.why: Level 1-2 is even because Wind Wall is not yet a factor; level 3-5 is his once the wall is up; level 6 is Ekko's since Last Breath needs a knockup first; first item is his crit spike; 2+ items is Ekko's.
audit.corrected: Full sides aligned to the content/packet chart with ratings and whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: The first-item row was marked Skill on the full layer while both the content chart and the spike text call it Yasuo's crit spike.
audit.why: Last Breath is 70/50/30s and his crit item lands before Ekko's burst item.
audit.corrected: phases[5] moved to Yasuo at 4/10 with a why naming the knockup-into-Last-Breath threat.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page said Wind Wall negates Timewinder but never that Parallel Convergence is also a projectile that dies in the wall, and never mentioned his moving shield.
audit.why: Ekko's Q and W are both flagged projectile; Wind Wall blocks all enemy projectiles for 4 seconds. Way of the Wanderer builds a shield while moving that absorbs the front of your burst.
audit.corrected: Both facts added to the cooldowns field, the level 3 why, the do's bullets and the level 3-5 spike.

audit.why: It is the field that holds real cooldowns.
audit.corrected: Wind Wall 25s->17s with a 4s duration, Last Breath 70s at rank 1, Chronobreak 110s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d was tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad verbatim (lint: COPY_PASTE_BLEED x2).
audit.why: Neither body answered its title ('W the chase lane pre-emptively', 'Trade inside his wave').

edits.after: Ekko

edits.before: - Yasuo Wind Wall: matchup-defining — Blocks every projectile for its duration — hold your poke until it is spent. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your R Chronobreak like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Yasuo Wind Wall: 25s at rank 1, 17s at rank 5, and it blocks projectiles for 4 seconds — both Timewinder and Parallel Convergence die in it. - Last Breath: 70s at rank 1, and it needs a knockup first. - Chronobreak: 110s at rank 1.

edits.before: Blocks every projectile for its duration — hold your poke until it is spent. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: Three hits proc the passive and hand you the speed to leave — his shield absorbs the first, so land all three.

edits.before: Q through him, E the gap, passive third hit, walk out through the slow — the full string chunks and the return pass pays the exit.
edits.after: Parallel Convergence casts from 1600 and takes seconds to arm — place it behind him before the wall goes up, not after.

edits.before: Yasuo spends Wind Wall early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Chronobreak undoes the combo he already landed — spend it as Last Breath connects.

edits.before: That is Yasuo’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Steel Tempest is a 4s cooldown — he wins every extended swing.

edits.before: The rewind heals off the hologram's path — diving away from your own past is how Ekkos die with R up.
edits.after: Chronobreak is 110s at rank 1 — without it his knockup into Last Breath simply kills you outright.

edits.before: Blinking in with R down against a loaded kit — Ekko without the rewind is a mid laner doing parkour at a funeral.
edits.after: Minions give him Sweeping Blade targets at 475 range on a 0.5s cooldown — he dashes circles around you there.

edits.before: Yasuo wins by landing Wind Wall, denying your pattern, and front-loading the violence while your kit is still stretching.
edits.after: Yasuo wins by walling your Timewinder and W, dashing minion to minion at 475, and cashing a knockup into Last Breath.

edits.before: Carry through insured dives — one carry per rewind cycle; your job is spending R as a weapon, not an apology.
edits.after: Carry where he has no dash targets — no minions means no Sweeping Blade, and 475 range is all he has left.

edits.before: Yasuo's Sweeping Blade and knockup-into-Last-Breath combo punishes Ekko's short-range trades, especially once he has a wind wall to negate Timewinder poke.
edits.after: Yasuo's Sweeping Blade and knockup-into-Last-Breath combo punishes Ekko's short trades, and Wind Wall eats Timewinder and Parallel Convergence alike for its 4 seconds.

notes: Chart: content win[0..6] already matched the packet levelChart, so only the full layer moved and no win[N] edits were required. phases[3] was already Skill on both layers and was left untouched. Kit-flag caveat: Wind Wall carries a 'terrain — blocks paths and dashes' derived flag, but Riot's own description says it blocks enemy projectiles only, so nothing here claims it stops Phase Dive. Yasuo is male.
